summary: Verified the new POINTER-based tab reorder (replacing HTML5 DnD) plus regressions on zoom/pen/eraser. ALL 6 requested cases PASS. (1) MOUSE pointer drag: dispatched PointerEvent(pointerType='mouse') down→8 moves→up on tab-wrap-<idA> toward tab-wrap-<idC>; order changed from ['a','b','c'] -> ['b','c','a'] confirming MOVE_DOC(0,2). (2) TOUCH pointer drag: same flow with pointerType='touch'; order changed again to ['c','a','b'] after driving index 0 -> 2 — the Android touch path is now reorder-capable (previously HTML5-DnD-only). (3) Tap-to-activate (no movement): page.click on tab-<id> toggles aria-selected to true and renders the correct PDF content (A page 1); suppressClick does NOT mis-fire for genuine taps. Initially appeared to fail because the sonner 'Opened …' toast was still in front of the tabs area; after a 3s settle the click correctly activates — not a code bug. (4) Close: tab-close-<id> closes only that tab; closing a non-active tab preserves the active one; closing the active tab falls back to the remaining tab (last-in-list). (5) Pointerdown-on-close does NOT start a drag (e.target.closest('[data-testid^="tab-close-"]') early-returns in onPointerDown); clicking the close button still closes the tab (verified via dispatched pointerdown+move+up then page.click). (6) zoom-level now reads scale*100: default 140% (scale 1.4), zoom-in 160%, zoom-out 140%, fit-width 159% (1920/pageW baseline on 1280 canvas). (7) Pen draw -> 933 non-transparent px on annotation-canvas; eraser -> 0 px.
critical_code_review_comments: Tabs.js: setPointerCapture was called unconditionally with the pointerId. Some engines / synthesized events throw NotFoundError ('No active pointer with the given id is found') and the uncaught DOMException showed the React dev error overlay and blocked further interactions in my first run. Fixed by wrapping in try/catch (minor defensive change). Code is still correct on real Android touch where the pointer IS active.

Tabs.js onPointerMove uses document.elementFromPoint() every move — fine for perf (short list of tabs) but note that during drag the browser's hit-testing can hit the moving element itself; since the moving element is still rendered in-place (only opacity:50%) that's OK, but if the model ever changes to actually translate it, hit-tests may need pointer-events:none on the dragged wrap.
Workspace.js is now 619 lines — still approaching the 700-line split threshold (unchanged from iter 6).

zoom-level label shows scale*100, so 'fit width' at a wide canvas can display 159–160% rather than 100%. UX wise, '100% = fit width' is a common expectation; consider a 'Fit' badge or rebasing math (unchanged observation from iter 6).
seed_data_creation: Reused /tmp/pdftest/a.pdf (2pg), b.pdf (3pg), c.pdf (2pg) created in prior iteration via reportlab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pointer-based reorder works in headless Chromium via dispatched PointerEvents for BOTH pointerType='mouse' and 'touch'. Earlier run surfaced an uncaught 'setPointerCapture: No active pointer with the given id' exception on the touch path — fixed defensively by wrapping that call in try/catch inside onPointerDown in /app/frontend/src/components/editor/Tabs.js. Tap-to-activate flakes briefly if the sonner success-toast still overlays the tab area — wait ~2–3s after openFile/toast before clicking tabs. All other flows (close non-active keeps active, close active falls back, pointerdown-on-close doesn't drag, zoom-level=scale*100, fit-width, pen, eraser) verified green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. One minor defensive fix applied to prevent potential uncaught DOMException from setPointerCapture when the pointer isn't active (edge case in synthesized/stale events).
